If you're cutting for a weight class or a weigh-in, talk to a sports dietitian or your coach about a safe approach, and if you feel dizzy, faint, or have chest pain at any point, stop and get help right away. I'm glad to help you build a training plan that fits your goals in a way that won't put you at risk."}
